messages.author: 671b14edc9322fa7
messages.subject: Re: model syntax problem
parts: On 03 Sep 2014, at 9:38 , Jia-Jen Chen <student...@gmail.com> wrote:

I want to know how to write different latent variables' errors are correlated. For example, f1~~f2 means two latent variables are correlated, but not latent variables' errors. So, what is the expression in lavaan syntax? (still "~~" or .... ?!)
Thanks for help =)

The syntax f1~~f2 refers to the covariance of the part of f1 and f2 that are not explained by other latent variables. If f1 and f2 are endogenous, then it refers to the covariance of their errors. If f1 and f2 are exogenous, then it refers to the covariance of f1 and f2 itself. 

If f1 and f2 are endogenous, then their covariance is not a model parameter. If they are exogenous, then they do not have errors.

Mikko
